As of September 27, 2026, we estimate that our obligation for future payments under the TRA totaled $343.2 million.

The payments that we are required to make will generally reduce the amount of overall cash flow that might have otherwise been available to us, but we expect the cash tax savings we will realize to fund the required payments.

Assuming no material changes in relevant tax law and that we earn sufficient taxable income to realize all tax benefits that are subject to the TRA, we estimate that the tax savings associated with all tax attributes described above would aggregate to approximately $403.8 million as of September 27, 2026.
We expect a payment of $2.3 million relating to tax year 2025 to be paid within the next 12 months.
